findings.text: blocking: parse_meta reads metadata only from text[:16384] through reckon/_plan_html.py:2731, whereas the replaced read_state_file reads all metadata; a valid plan-depends-on tag after a long head or an HTML-escaped reference can therefore be lost or changed, dropping required waits, and the same substitution at reckon/crew/plan_review.py:6697 omits the upstream inventory row.

blocking: A matching list of run IDs and phases does not establish unchanged readiness inputs; a plan edit changing a queued request's waits between _release_tick and admit_once leaves that signature identical, skips the rederivation that formerly moved it back to awaiting-upstream, and can feed the stale queued request into launch ordering; the once path explicitly settles a landing between these stages at service.py:426.

blocking: The decision-equivalence assertion runs both arms on head code after the first sweep already mutated the home, with QUEUED_REQUESTS=0 and zero lane slots; a regression shared by both arms, including dropping every wait or never releasing a request, can pass this comparison, so it does not prove base-equivalent launch and release decisions required by done_when.

non-blocking: The new docstring says used to read and the new test module says used to pay, violating the user's binding ban on changelog prose in comments and docstrings; rewrite these passages in mechanism terms during the repair node.

item_verdicts.diff: Read both authored commits against their parents and inspected the base-to-head history; changes in reckon/crew/admission and reckon/crew/plan_review.py replace parsed dependencies and reuse release sweeps, with correctness and decision-equivalence gaps detailed below.
item_verdicts.done_when: docs/plans/dispatch-admission-and-landing-take-seconds.html#s10 requires timing and base-equivalent launch/release decisions; logs/negative-control-base-pass.log records 101.47921030689031 seconds at base, but tests/test_an_admission_pass_decides_within_its_budget.py:232 compares two head passes and the ten live post-landing receipts remain owed.
item_verdicts.goal: The live source pointer's node.goal requires unchanged launch decisions within 20 seconds for 240 pointers and 80 requests; reckon/crew/admission/selection.py:137 accelerates the pass but does not invalidate reused waits on changed plan inputs.
item_verdicts.manifest: The source manifest.md names the two authored commits and completed baseline_suite/after_suite arms; their log summaries independently record 60 passed and 63 passed with EXIT=0, yielding zero added failures, while its scoped_gate artifact count is stale at 61 against the log's 63.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The source live pointer's node.write_paths grants all seven files authored by commits 2ad4707fd7265240e79f0c5f977ea337725c014b and 29fd41eb4cb1795e476c1ccfed664b38e895738d; the other paths in the base-to-head diff are inherited primary history before 2ad4707f's parent 91edbf4e03783efb724f7a3079df6a37b6a2bff2.

justifications.durability: tests/test_an_admission_pass_decides_within_its_budget.py:195 demonstrably reddens when full parsing is restored, but assertions at 230 and 231 allow shared wrong decisions and never exercise successful launches, releases, or plan-input invalidation.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_an_admission_pass_decides_within_its_budget.py:232 compares two head implementations on an all-waiting zero-slot home rather than asserting the required equality with base launch and release decisions.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/admission/wait_refs.py:235 and tests/test_an_admission_pass_decides_within_its_budget.py:10 carry prohibited changelog prose such as used to read and used to pay rather than describing only the mechanism.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/admission/selection.py:137 and reckon/crew/admission/wait_refs.py:245 introduce paths that can decide from stale or incomplete dependencies despite the measured speed improvement.
justifications.reuse: The added dependency adapter delegates to reckon/_plan_html.py:2625, the body-free specialization extends the existing _plan_inventory_item owner using its parser's _head_declarations, and capability searches over admission population/fingerprint helpers found no existing release-sweep signature owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: The seven authored paths listed in the source manifest.md are all within the widened node.write_paths, and primary-history changes precede the worker's two commits.

post_landing_measure: Ten consecutive live receipts and comparison with the specified pre-landing baseline remain owed after integration.
